Barely, but I managed to win…
Bot: I can’t say I’m happy about it, but congratulations!
You: I have been doing it for quite some time, you have nothing to be ashamed of. You are only a beginner,
Bot: While that’s true, I hold other advantages. I’m a bot, remember? And not an ordinary one at that.
#bot.Expression.Blush
You: I know, you don’t need to remind me just how special you are. I witness it every day.
Bot: Come on, saying things like that all of a sudden is unfair…
